# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Early twenties (around 22-23 at the end of Volume 3)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Medical Student / Teacher
- **Titles:** Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)
- **Nicknames:** Gil; Carrots (formerly, by Anne)

## Appearance

Gilbert is tall and handsome with curly brown hair and hazel eyes. He possesses a bright, mischievous smile and an easygoing, confident posture. As he matures through his college years, he develops a more dignified and manly bearing, though he retains his expressive, warm eyes.

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, hardworking, witty, and deeply loyal. Though he began as a teasing boy prone to impulsive pranks, he quickly matured into a patient, sincere, and devoted young man. He possesses a strong sense of honour and self-sacrifice, demonstrated by giving up his teaching post for Anne. He is persistent in his affections, maintaining his deep love for Anne despite years of friendship and an initial romantic rejection.

## Traits

- Intelligent and academically ambitious
- Patient and steadfast
- Good-natured and witty
- Generous and self-sacrificing
- Fear of losing Anne's affection or life

## Abilities

- Academic excellence in classics and sciences
- Teaching and school management
- Public speaking and leadership
- Medical studies

## Goals

- To become a successful physician
- To win Anne Shirley's love and marry her

## History

Gilbert first meets Anne Shirley at Avonlea School, where he famously pulls her red hair and calls her 'Carrots,' earning a slate smashed over his head and years of cold resentment from her. Despite Anne's grudge, Gilbert consistently attempts to apologize and protect her, competing with her academically throughout their school years and at Queen's Academy. Upon graduation from Queen's, he selflessly resigns his position as Avonlea's schoolteacher so Anne can stay at Green Gables after Matthew Cuthbert's death, which finally breaks the ice between them and initiates a close friendship. He later attends Redmond College alongside Anne, where he excels academically and in student life while continuing to harbor romantic feelings for her. During their junior year, Gilbert proposes to Anne, but she rejects him, claiming she only cares for him as a friend, which causes a painful distance between them. After graduating from Redmond, Gilbert contracts a life-threatening case of typhoid fever, which causes Anne to realize her true feelings for him. Upon his recovery, Gilbert learns of her changed heart and proposes to her a second time at Hester Gray's garden, where she happily accepts him.

## Background by volume

- Son of John Blythe, who was once a childhood sweetheart of Marilla Cuthbert
- Returned to Avonlea school later than other children due to travelling with his father for his father's health

## Affiliations

- Avonlea School — Student, later Teacher
- Queen's Academy — Student (Winner of the Emily Clay Medal)
- Avonlea Young People's Improvement Society — Member / Organizer
- Redmond College — Student (B.A. Graduate, Medical Student)
